items.name: command-deck
items.title: Command Deck
items.description: A keyboard-first action picker with search, shortcut hints, and an inline result.

useCases: In-page command menus and searchable action lists.
limitations: The deck is inline. Shortcut hints do not register application shortcuts.
requirements: Supply actions with unique IDs and connect action callbacks. Enable Command/Ctrl+K on at most one deck per page.

items.name: status-capsule
items.title: Status Capsule
items.description: A collapsible task summary with a progress ring, file details, and retry states.

useCases: Collapsible upload, export, and background-job summaries with per-task state.
limitations: Presentation only. The caller owns jobs, retries, downloads, and consistency between task status and progress.
requirements: Requires React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4. Supply tasks with unique IDs, job state, and action callbacks. Reduced motion disables transitions and spinner rotation.

items.name: orbit-dial
items.title: Orbit Dial
items.description: A circular control with radial ticks, a numeric readout, and a native range slider.

useCases: Numeric adjustments in creative tools, audio interfaces, and settings panels.
limitations: One numeric value with a linear scale. Values snap to complete steps from the minimum. Long formatted values are truncated.
requirements: Supply a label and connect onValueChange for controlled use. Requires React, Tailwind CSS 4, and the background, foreground, border, and muted text theme tokens.

items.name: peel-stack
items.title: Peel Stack
items.description: A layered paper stack that rotates through collections with buttons, arrow keys, or a swipe.

useCases: Layered collections, portfolio studies, and attachment cards with manual navigation.
limitations: Shows up to three visible layers. Cards have a fixed height; increase it for long content. Demo artwork is not installed.
requirements: Supply items with unique IDs. Uses React 19, Tailwind CSS 4, and theme tokens. Inactive cards are inert; reduced motion disables transitions.

items.name: ascii-morph
items.title: ASCII Morph
items.description: A cloud of characters that morphs into a globe, a flower, and an A1 monogram.

useCases: Interactive ASCII illustrations for landing pages, portfolios, and identity studies.
limitations: Three built-in silhouettes only: globe, flower, and A1. Does not convert images or arbitrary text into ASCII.
requirements: React and Tailwind CSS. Uses SVG, requestAnimationFrame, matchMedia, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion switches shapes instantly. No automatic animation or pause control is needed.

items.name: integration-hub
items.title: Integration Hub
items.description: A connected workspace with six tools and animated pulses flowing into a central product.

useCases: Product integration diagrams with up to six tools, inward pulses, and optional tool selection.
limitations: Visualization only. No account connections, synchronization, or live activity data. Extra tools beyond six are ignored.
requirements: Supply tools with unique IDs and a product. Icons are React nodes. Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Reduced motion retains static connections.

items.name: ascii-terrain
items.title: ASCII Terrain
items.description: A landscape made of characters, with rolling hills, pointer sculpting, and click ripples.

useCases: Interactive ASCII landscapes and decorative hero backgrounds.
limitations: Procedural illustration only. No geographic data or persistent terrain editing. JavaScript is required to draw.
requirements: Supply a pause control for automatic motion. Requires Canvas 2D, ResizeObserver, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion shows a static landscape.

items.name: text-banner
items.title: Text Banner
items.description: Bold text and staggered pixel separators in a seamless, infinitely scrolling banner.

useCases: Continuously scrolling words or phrases with separators for page banners.
limitations: Plain text only. Repeated content is decorative and cannot contain links or controls.
requirements: Supply items and a pause control using the paused prop. Requires ResizeObserver. Reduced motion displays one static sequence.

items.name: confirmation-button
items.title: Confirmation Button
items.description: A drag-to-confirm button with a dotted arrow, pending feedback, and a confirmed state.

useCases: Deliberate confirmation actions with drag, keyboard, and asynchronous feedback.
limitations: The app supplies the action. Dragging is left to right, and success stays visible until remount.
requirements: Requires React 19.2 or later. Supply onConfirm. Return a promise for asynchronous work and reject it to allow retry. Change the React key to reset.

items.name: shape-flow
items.title: Shape Flow
items.description: Text that reflows around a draggable X, powered by Pretext.

useCases: Editorial text wrapping around a draggable X shape.
limitations: One left-to-right plain-text paragraph. Rich text and right-to-left flow are unsupported.
requirements: Use a loaded named font. Interactive layout needs Canvas 2D, Intl.Segmenter, and ResizeObserver.

items.name: crypto-wallet
items.title: Crypto Wallet
items.description: A wallet overview with token balances, recent activity, and send, receive, and swap actions.

useCases: Wallet account overview, token holdings, and transaction activity.
limitations: Presentation only. No wallet SDK, balance fetching, signing, or transaction submission is included.
requirements: Supply account data and callbacks from the app wallet integration.

items.name: select-menu
items.title: Select Menu
items.description: A dropdown selector with icons, descriptions, and keyboard navigation.

useCases: Single-choice dropdowns with icons, descriptions, and keyboard navigation.
limitations: Single selection only; search and multi-select are not provided.
requirements: Supply options, a controlled value, onValueChange, and an accessible ariaLabel.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Reveals new text from left to right through a scramble of random characters.

useCases: Animating changing headings, labels, or status text through scrambled characters.
limitations: The initial text does not animate. Animation starts when the text prop changes.
requirements: Update the text prop to animate. Use a monospace font to reduce width shifts.

items.name: multichain-swap
items.title: Multichain Swap
items.description: A crypto swap form with network selection, token balances, and cross-chain quote details.

useCases: Token swap forms with network selection, balances, slippage, and quote review.
limitations: No live quotes, wallet connection, bridge execution, or transaction submission is included.
requirements: Control the form value and supply wallet and quote callbacks. Select Menu is included in this item.

items.name: section-rail
items.title: Section Rail
items.description: A compact reading rail that tracks progress through page sections.

useCases: Table of contents and reading progress for long pages with sections.
limitations: Tracks existing DOM sections; it does not create the page content.
requirements: Match every item ID to a section element on the page.

items.name: spiral-text
items.title: Spiral Text
items.description: Text set on a responsive spiral that tightens under pressure and ripples on release.

useCases: Decorative spiral typography with pointer interaction.
limitations: A decorative text composition, not a reading paragraph or changing-label effect.
requirements: Supply text and room for the responsive spiral.

items.name: particle-menu
items.title: Particle Menu
items.description: Grainy symbols that scatter around your pointer and spring back into place.

useCases: Artistic navigation with interactive particle symbols.
limitations: A specialized visual navigation treatment, not a general dropdown selector.
requirements: Supply labeled items with supported shapes and navigation destinations.

items.name: arc-reel
items.title: Arc Reel
items.description: An infinitely looping reel with curved provider cards and synchronized scroll controls.

useCases: Looping galleries, provider cards, or logo reels with drag and keyboard controls.
limitations: Supply your own artwork; demo images are not installed.
